title: BlockDefinitionDocument
description: Is a block definition with description, components, and permutations.

permutations.title: Permutations
permutations.description: Array of conditional component overrides. Each permutation has a Molang condition and components that override the base components when the condition is true.

defaultSnippets.label: Block Components
defaultSnippets.description: Container for all components that define custom block behavior and properties. Components control collision, selection boxes, destruction time, light emission, flammability, placement rules, crafting table functionality, and more. Combine components to create unique blocks with specific gameplay characteristics.

components.x-runtime-constraint-description: Block cannot have both a "container" in "minecraft:block_entity" and a "minecraft:crafting_table" component.

description.title: Description
description.description: Information about the block, must have at minimum an "identifier" and can have also the following optional field "menu_category", "states" and/or "traits"
